digest.component_or_area: reclaim window helper — git bundle backup and manifest preparation
propositions: A helper script must enumerate all live origin heads and tags at runtime, collapse annotated-tag peeled OIDs, and record exact direct and peeled object IDs in a JSON manifest without hardcoded ref counts.

The helper must classify each enumerated commit ref by its ancestry relationship to the old tickets tip (same, ancestor, descendant, diverged, or unrelated) and record non-commit refs without ancestry queries.

The helper must refuse execution on partial or promisor clones, refuse artifact output paths inside the repository, its Git directory, or any registered worktree, and never overwrite pre-existing artifacts.
The helper must create a git bundle containing the old tip and requested pin refs, verify it with git bundle verify, restore it into a throwaway repository, and confirm exact OID reproduction.
The helper must perform no remote push, delete, or mutation and must record byte-identical origin heads/tags state before and after successful execution.
